activity.notes: The custom-civilization label 'Pergamon (Attalus)' refers specifically to Attalus I Soter. The British Museum identifies him as ruler of Pergamum from 241 to 197 BCE, taking the royal title around 230 BCE. ATLAS records the full rulership interval rather than starting only when he adopted the title basileus.
